New name “SmartFormular FiBu lite” in title and header, new look “night and violet” – dark surface, light type, violet as the accent. Functionality, file name and addresses are unchanged.

e-invoice-viewer.neuigkeiten:
### Version cde559c, 10 November 2026

Take over an invoice: on the “Create” tab you can take over an existing invoice as a Word file, PDF, OpenDocument, Excel or text file. The tool reads it in this browser only, fills in the recipient, line items, number and dates, and compares the amount with the document. You check it, add anything missing and save it as an XRechnung.

### Version 485de8d, 8 November 2026

Checking stays free: reading and checking on this page stay free of charge and need no sign-in, from 2027 too. From 1 January 2027, creating invoices and the downloadable file require a licence – before that you get a free four-week trial from your first sign-in. Until 31 December 2026 nothing changes.

### Version ce5a845, 8 November 2026

New: create e-invoices. In the “Create” tab you write an XRechnung: enter your company details once, add the recipient and items – the tool remembers recipients and frequent items and suggests them as you type; both lists can also be imported as CSV. If needed, you write an interim, recurring or cancellation invoice, or use an earlier invoice as a template. The check against the official rules runs as you type; the file is saved only when there are no errors left, as an XML file with a printable view and a GiroCode. Everything stays in your browser only. The tool does not archive: keep the XML file.

Licence checking set up: the file now contains the verification key for signing in from 1 January 2027. Nothing changes until then.

Prepared for 2027: From 1 January 2027 you sign in with a code sent by email – no password. The first four weeks are a free trial, after that there is a licence for one year. Without a connection the tool keeps working for up to 30 days. Nothing changes until 31 December 2026.

### Version f44b34b, 1 November 2026

Free to try until 31 December 2026: from 1 January 2027 the page and the file show a note on how to get a licence for continued use instead of the drop zone. Nothing changes until then.
